template.title: Announce on Discord when you go live on YouTube
template.description: When StreamGremlin finds your live YouTube broadcast, posts @everyone in a Discord channel with its title and link. Add a Discord webhook on Connections first.

blanks.hint: Your Discord webhook's name, like announcements

workflow.name: Announce on Discord when you go live on YouTube

with.message: I'm live on YouTube! Come hang out${event.payload.?url.orValue("") != "" ? ": " + event.payload.url : "."}
with.title: ${event.payload.?title.orValue("")}
